reviewContext.userProblem: Installed package workflow validate/inspect loses locked external add-on dependency metadata and reports false unresolvedAddonExecutable for native/container add-ons.
requiredOutcomes: Preserve verified owning-package identity and locked native/container add-on metadata through installed workflow name and direct-directory resolution.
Keep unrelated direct workflows and unknown, ambiguous, or mismatched dependencies failing closed while preserving scope precedence and environment requirements.
Run focused Swift tests, SwiftLint, source build, installed-package validate/inspect, and all 75 example validations with complete exit-status evidence.
Obtain independent implementation review acceptance, then commit and non-force push the source fix for package migration verification.
nonGoals: No provider/model/network calls, native/container execution, package repository edits, release, or merge.
No schema migration, new registry protocol, global vendor allowlist, generalized resolver framework, or broad cleanup.
constraints: Preserve #116 and the all-75-example schema correction already at source HEAD 0c66cb19ffa2619af440ab640701756d35b443a4.
Keep all scratch in repository-root tmp/, with per-plan and per-attempt evidence and final numeric exit statuses; preserve unrelated worktrees.
Reproduce with the real filesystem resolver before changing production code; use the built source CLI and isolated child HOME for fixtures.
One implementation owner writes its progress file; reconcile shared tree serially before independent review and Git finalization.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Carry manifest and package directory together in ResolvedWorkflowBundle only when canonical selected workflow directory proves package ownership; names and vendor prefixes do not prove ownership.
Reuse existing installed dependency and integrity checks to require a unique exact identity, lock version, digest, execution-kind, and scope match before host projection.
Retain Core's unresolvedAddonExecutable guard and native/container readiness checks; verified dependencies need no invented host executable.
Resolve reachable callees with their own package context and preserve current validate/inspect JSON and exit conventions.
intentionalTradeoffs: A narrow resolution/projection fix defers broad resolver refactoring.
Remaining unrelated example failures may be accepted only with exact command, diagnostic, baseline comparison, and review disposition.
supportedEdgeCases: Scoped package IDs, omitted node versions bound to locks, and installed workflow name or direct-directory selection.
Unrelated/copied direct workflows, unknown or ambiguous add-ons, mismatched identity/version/digest/execution kind, and project/user collisions fail closed.
Required package/node environment bindings, independent readiness, cross-workflow callees, built-ins, declarative add-ons, and local-command executable checks.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live native/container or provider execution and package migration in the sibling package repository.
New add-on registry protocols or authorization inferred from a name alone.
reviewDecisions: Step 3 independent design review accepted with no findings (comm-000004).
Step 5 independent plan review accepted with no findings (comm-000006).
reviewContext.evidencePolicy: Store new implementation evidence under tmp/issue-117/implementation/<planId>/attempt-N; retained tmp/issue-117 planning evidence remains read-only context.

acceptanceCriteria: Real installed native/container package workflows validate and inspect without false unresolvedAddonExecutable and preserve exact locked metadata.
Unrelated direct workflows and unknown, ambiguous, mismatched, or lower-priority dependencies fail closed without weakening integrity or readiness checks.
Focused tests, lint, build, installed-package CLI matrix, and all 75 example validations have complete evidence or precisely reviewed remaining failures.
